title: On Lending the cousin two whole pounds
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：lend　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lend 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the tailor ① lent the cousin two whole pounds twice over, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② lends the cousin two whole pounds year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ lend the cousin two whole pounds at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ lent the cousin two whole pounds before — a line in the order for November 1961 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Lending the cousin two whole pounds twice over, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ lend the plan their blessing year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Lend the plan their blessing at once and never mention it again.

By 1974 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ lends the plan their blessing twice over every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ lent the cousin two whole pounds again when nobody else would.

⑩ To lend the cousin two whole pounds, my mother said in 1979, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody lends the cousin two whole pounds year after year again and somebody must lend the cousin two whole pounds twice over all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 借给（一般过去式 lent the cousin two whole pounds：1967 年裁缝头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 借给（一般现在 lends the cousin two whole pounds：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 借给（不定式 to lend the cousin two whole pounds：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 借给（过去完成时 had lent the cousin two whole pounds：1961 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 借给（动名词 lending the cousin two whole pounds 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 给予（lend the plan their blessing：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去给予对那套方案表示赞许）
G. v. 给予（lend the plan their blessing：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 借给（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 lends the plan their blessing，而母亲又一次 lent the cousin two whole pounds）

lend 意为“借给”，结尾那句是母亲 1979 年的话：要借给借给表弟整整两镑，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 lend 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1967 the tailor lent the cousin two whole pounds twice over, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor lends the cousin two whole pounds year after year whenever the shop asks.
Lending the cousin two whole pounds twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever lend the plan their blessing year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop lends the plan their blessing twice over every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother lent the cousin two whole pounds again, and the shop remembered that half.
